note: v464: Expenses and invoices now have a 'Bank account' field (shown when you have 2+ banks connected) so you can set which account each one clears through / reconciles with. A record tagged to one account no longer shows up — or gets suggested — while you reconcile another account. It's the same tag as the reconcile screen's 'Paid from' button, just built into the forms so you can set it as you go.
